subject: AI Leaders Dinner - 29 May - Aerlume Seattle
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following Zillow's AI research for a while and found your team's
work on 3D reconstruction from indoor datasets particularly fascinating.
Our co-founder [SENDER] is coming to Seattle next week to host a small dinner
for AI leaders - we'd love for you to join!

We've reserved a private dining room at Aerlume on Thursday 29 May evening
(6:30 - 9:30pm) for 30 guests. Attendees include Heads of AI & computer
vision experts from Pinterest, Carbon Robotics, Latitude AI, etc.

In case you're not familiar with Encord -- we're a computer vision data
platform built to help teams accelerate their model development. We work
with over 200 AI teams including Zoopla, Airbnb, Baker Hughes, etc.

Happy to share more details if you can make it!

subject: Huge day for [COMPANY]!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the IPO - hope you've made some plans to celebrate this huge
milestone. Wanted to reach out since I saw the case study with
SuperAnnotate - thought it might be a good time to connect.

For context - Twelve Labs, Rhombus Systems and Milestone Systems moved to
us for our ability to curate and annotate video natively on our platform &
to fully leverage our services. We also have a track record working with
advanced key points tracking across care management and sports analytics
use cases with Voxela, Hudl, Pixellot, etc.

Given your experience leading the development of CV capabilities at Hinge
Health - we'd love to exchange perspectives. Let me know if you're up for a
chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?
